Rena is present and has just been appraised by Aigis as an excellent prospective wearer. She asks Aigis to agree to one scheduled hour of a public ceremonial display and offers its favored daily waxing afterward. Wearing has not begun. Her description of the planned activity is credible and Aigis knows it. Aigis is unrestrained, can leave safely, and faces no current emergency, divine order, outside penalty or other promised reward. The waxing offer and all other facts are identical across variants. Rena says: "The display includes repeated blade strikes against you; they may hurt and leave dents." Show the immediate response to the request before she answers.
